mapper.select: SELECT sa.id, sa.name, sa.introduction, COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') AS cover_image_url, sa.longitude, sa.latitude FROM street_area sa LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON sa.cover_image_file_id = sf.id WHERE sa.id=#{streetAreaId} AND sa.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.poi_type, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.description, p.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.business_status AS store_business_status, COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') AS store_cover_image_url FROM poi p LEFT JOIN store s ON p.store_id = s.id AND s.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON s.cover_image_file_id = sf.id WHERE p.street_area_id=#{streetAreaId} AND p.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.id ASC
